releaseNotes:
New in Locations: a guide to six Stardust City districts: Lumina Core, Aether Heights, Verdant Flux Gardens, Neon Drift Market, Iron Pulse Ward and Lumen Coast.
New NPCs: Unit SERAPH (Kael Vire, Seris Vale, Dax Renn and Nyx-7), plus Karther and Nova Ember.
New in Files: dossiers on Stardust, Inc., EIDOLON, EIDOLON Gamma, Unit SERAPH, THORN and the Warrior-Monks.
Updated: Lumi Frost.
Fixed: a typo on Narg's page.
New: Downtime on the main menu. Try your luck at the Stardrop Dice Houses and Flux Tables with Stardrop, Black Hole and Crystal Hold. Show your result card to the GM to collect. At the table there's no limit; at home you can stake 1 Crystal a week.
New: tap a place on the World Map or Stardust City Map to open its page, and look for the "You are here" marker.
Skill videos now download the first time you play them, so the app is much smaller. Use the Skill Videos button on the main menu to get them all at once for offline play.
The app now checks for new content whenever you switch back to it.
Fixed: the Stats screen now counts the spell slots you have already bought as soon as the app opens.
